opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, Bram speaking. How can I help you?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which is exactly what the opening standard asks for.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com. Your next order confirmation will go there.
verification.comment: You changed the account email and shared order status without first confirming the caller's full name plus an order number or account postcode; verify identity before any account change or order detail.

understanding.comment: You captured the caller's request to change the email and asked for the new address without repeating questions, which is good.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this morning and arrives in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 2 to 4 working day standard delivery timeline is correct for the order, so the statement is accurate on the facts given.

process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo or dispute step applied to this call, so no required process steps were missed.

communication.comment: The caller was not frustrated, so no acknowledgement was needed, but the reply was curt; a warmer tone would be better.

closing.comment: You did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else, and ended the call abruptly; close by summarising what happens next and asking if there is anything else.
